name: Originals
summary: StudioZero's own shorts: movie and story recaps (stock footage, narration) and AI-animated series.

sources.name: TMDB
sources.attribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB

link.note: No link by default; a format may add one later.

callToAction.rule: No spoilers in the hook; recaps credit their sources.

budget.note: No paid generation without the owner's explicit OK for that run, with a cost estimate. The owner sets a monthly budget before Phase 5.

mix.note: Nothing scheduled until Originals has approved batches; the owner sets target shares before the Phase 4 mix policy.

checks.name: Rights
checks.how: every asset in render.json credits with a known licence (no 'unknown'); TMDB notice where TMDB data or images appear

checks.name: Script sanity
checks.how: the reviewer reads the script: no hallucinated plot points, no spoiler-only hook, no unsafe content

checks.name: Visual QA
checks.how: contact sheet and spot checks of every clip; no broken frames, no unreadable subtitles

checks.name: AI disclosure
checks.how: render.json disclosure matches the models used; realisticSynthetic set where real-looking
